hero.title: A clearer view of refugee services and interventions.
hero.body: RPCMS brings partner coordination, field reporting, assistance tracking, service requests, and monitoring into one connected platform, so coordinators can see what is planned, what is delivered, and where attention is needed.

preview.label: Illustrative preview of the coordinator dashboard, using fictional aggregate figures

process.title: One connected flow, from partner approval to shared reports
process.intro: Each step depends on the one before it. Information is checked once, then carried forward, so the dashboards show reviewed information rather than raw submissions.

1.title: Verify and approve response partners
1.body: Coordinators check registration documents and agreements before a partner can work in the system.
1.next: Only an approved partner can submit an intervention.

2.title: Plan and approve interventions
2.body: Partners describe what they will deliver, where, for whom, and with what funding. Coordinators approve, return, or reject each plan.
2.next: Only approved interventions can receive field reports.

3.title: Capture field activity
3.body: Field teams record activities and surveys on mobile forms, including offline submissions that sync when a connection returns.
3.next: Submitted reports queue for review against the approved plan.

4.title: Verify beneficiaries and review assistance history
4.body: Reported assistance is checked against assistance history to flag possible duplicates or gaps for a coordinator to decide.
4.next: Resolved checks confirm the figures that feed monitoring.

5.title: Receive and manage refugee service requests
5.body: Service requests are logged, assigned to an approved partner, tracked against a response time, and closed with a recorded outcome.
5.next: Case outcomes add to the picture of service coverage.

6.title: Monitor coverage, outcomes, and funding
6.body: Dashboards combine reviewed reports, resolved checks, and case outcomes to show coverage, gaps, and funding by area and sector.
6.next: Monitoring findings are compiled into periodic reports.

7.title: Share approved reports and keep an audit trail
7.body: Reports are signed off and shared with authorised partners. Every decision along the way is recorded with who made it and when.
7.next: The audit trail links each figure back to its decisions.

capabilities.title: What coordinators can do in RPCMS

partners.title: Partner coordination
partners.body: Review partner registrations, supporting documents, and agreements, then approve or suspend access. Document approvals and electronic signatures are tracked on each partner record.

gis.title: Intervention and GIS monitoring
gis.body: Approve intervention plans and see where activities take place on area-level maps, without exposing individual locations.

forms.title: Field forms and surveys
forms.body: Collect activity reports and surveys on mobile devices, including offline, and review each submission before it counts.

assistance.title: Assistance tracking
assistance.body: Check reported assistance against history to find possible duplicates or gaps, and record a decision for each flagged case.

services.title: Refugee service workflows
services.body: Log service requests, assign them to approved partners, and follow each to resolution. Requesters and partners receive notifications at each step.

reporting.title: Reporting and analytics
reporting.body: Compile reviewed information into national reports, sign them off, and share them with authorised partners. Integration monitoring shows whether data exchanges are current.

audiences.title: Built for everyone involved in the response
audiences.intro: What each person can see and do depends on their role. Access is granted by authorised administrators, not by self-registration.
audiences.firstRelease: The OPM Oversight Portal, the Partner Portal and the Field Operations Portal are available in this release. Other portals are planned and will be announced when they are ready.

opm.title: OPM and authorised government coordinators
opm.body: Approve partners and interventions, review field information, resolve assistance checks, manage service cases, and sign off national reports.

partners.title: Humanitarian and development partners
partners.body: Maintain the organisation profile and accreditation, submit intervention proposals, report field activities, assistance and expenditure, and respond to OPM decisions — for their own organisation only.

field.title: Settlement and field teams
field.body: Record visits, surveys and assistance on a phone, including offline, see what has synced, and follow up issues and referrals — for assigned work only.

refugees.title: Refugees seeking information or services
refugees.body: Will be able to find information and follow up service requests through channels designed for them.

privacy.title: Personal information stays with authorised users
privacy.body1: Personal refugee information in RPCMS is restricted to authorised users whose role requires it, and access is recorded.
privacy.body2: Public pages, including this one, show no case or beneficiary data. Any figures on public pages are aggregate and, in this prototype, fictional.
privacy.body3: Data is collected only for coordination and service delivery purposes.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Authorised OPM staff and authorised staff of accredited partner organisations can sign in. Accounts are created by administrators; there is no public registration.
faq.q2: Can the public view refugee records?
faq.a2: No. Refugee and beneficiary records are never shown on public pages. They are available only to authorised users with a role that requires them.
faq.q3: Can I submit a refugee service request here?
faq.a3: Not yet. Refugee service request channels are planned but not available in this release. Please continue to use the existing help desks and service points in your settlement.
faq.q4: What if I need access as a partner?
faq.a4: Your organisation's partner administrator invites users from the Partner Portal. New organisations should contact the Department of Refugees to be set up.
faq.contactBody: Official contact details will be published here before launch.
faq.contactPlaceholder: Placeholder — to be replaced with verified institutional contact details before launch.

about.title: About RPCMS
about.intro: The Refugee Partnership Coordination and Monitoring System (RPCMS) is being developed to help coordinate the refugee response in Uganda. The Office of the Prime Minister, Department of Refugees, is the beneficiary institution.
about.purposeBody: RPCMS connects partner coordination, intervention planning, field reporting, assistance tracking, service requests, and monitoring, so decisions are based on reviewed information and are recorded.
about.statusBody: This is a frontend prototype. It uses fictional records, and no external system is connected. Verification, notifications, electronic signatures, and data exchanges are simulated and labelled as such.
about.noEndorsement: This prototype does not display an official crest and should not be read as an official announcement.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: RPCMS aims to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA.
accessibility.m1: Text and interface colours meet contrast requirements, and status is never shown by colour alone.
accessibility.m2: All functions work with a keyboard, with a visible focus indicator.
accessibility.m3: Forms have labels, instructions, and clear error messages.
accessibility.m4: Pages work on small screens and slow connections, and respect reduced-motion settings.
accessibility.m5: The interface is available in English, Kiswahili, French, and Arabic, with right-to-left layout for Arabic.
accessibility.limitsBody: This prototype has not yet had an independent accessibility audit. Translations are drafts pending review by qualified translators.
accessibility.feedbackBody: A contact route for accessibility feedback will be published before launch.

intro.approved: Verified and locked details form part of your approved accreditation. You can propose changes to editable details; OPM reviews them before they apply.

profile.legendHelp: Editable: you can change it. Under review: OPM is reviewing it. Verified: confirmed by a registry check (simulated). Locked: part of the approved record, changed only through OPM.
profile.pendingTitle: Change request {ref} is under OPM review
profile.pendingBody: Submitted on {date}. The fields it covers are read-only until OPM decides.
profile.inReview: OPM is reviewing your application. You will be notified if changes are needed.
profile.readOnlyRole: Only your partner administrator can edit the organisation profile.
profile.draftHint: When the profile and documents are complete, submit the application from Accreditation.
profile.lockedAreas: Sectors and operating areas define your operating permissions. To change them, contact OPM or request renewal.
profile.verifiedNote: URSB and NGO Bureau outcomes are recorded by OPM and cannot be edited here.
profile.changeHint: Editable details you change are sent to OPM as one change request. Nothing changes on your approved record until OPM approves.
profile.reasonRequired: Explain why the details are changing.
profile.changeSubmitted: Change request sent to OPM for review.

hints.registrationNo: As shown on the certificate of registration.
hints.ngoPermitNo: As shown on the NGO operating permit.

issues.name: Enter the legal name.
issues.ngoPermitNo: Enter the NGO Bureau permit number.
issues.tinFormat: The TIN must be ten digits.
issues.contactEmailFormat: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.org.
issues.settlementIds: Choose at least one operating settlement.
issues.personnel: Add at least one key person with a name and role.
issues.personnelEmail: Enter a valid email address for each person.

accreditation.title: Accreditation and compliance
accreditation.intro: Draft profile → Submit application → Completeness review → Registration and compliance checks → Decision. OPM makes each decision; you see every step here.
accreditation.submitHint: The application, profile and documents go to OPM. Documents are reviewed by OPM; uploading does not authenticate them.
accreditation.resubmitHint: Your corrections go back to the OPM review queue with your response.
accreditation.renewalRequested: Renewal requested. OPM will review it.
accreditation.suspendedNext: Next steps: resolve the issue, upload any missing document, and reply to OPM from Messages. New proposals cannot be submitted until the suspension is lifted. Existing records remain visible.
accreditation.stillNeeded: Still needed before you can resubmit:
accreditation.rejectedBody: OPM rejected the application. The decision and reason are in the history below. Contact OPM through Messages for next steps.
accreditation.inReview: OPM is reviewing your application. Verification outcomes are recorded by OPM.
accreditation.verificationHint: OPM runs these checks. You cannot edit the outcomes. In this prototype they are simulated: no registry was contacted.

upload.hint: Simulated upload: the file name and size are recorded, but the file is not stored.
upload.notAuthenticated: Uploading records a new version for OPM to review. It does not prove a document is genuine: OPM verifies content, and in this prototype no file is stored.

documents.title: Organisation documents
documents.intro: Registration certificates, licences, compliance documents and evidence. Every version is kept.
documents.expiryHint: Leave blank if the document does not expire.
documents.versionsHint: Earlier versions are kept on record and are never overwritten.
documents.replaceHint: The new version goes to OPM for review. The current version stays in the history.
documents.uploadHint: Upload the document. It goes to OPM for review with your application.
documents.returnedHint: OPM returned this document. Read the comment and upload a corrected version.
documents.missingHint: This required document has not been uploaded yet.

proposals.title: Intervention proposals
proposals.intro: Draft, submit and track proposals. Drafts are private to your organisation until submitted.
proposals.newIntro: A guided form. Save a draft at any point; every rule is checked before you submit.
proposals.noPermission: Only your partner administrator can create and submit proposals.
proposals.draftPrivate: Drafts are private to your organisation. OPM sees the proposal only when you submit it.

fields.title: Title
fields.overlapResponse: How will you coordinate with the overlapping work?

proposals.locationHint: Describe the zones or villages. Do not include household locations.
proposals.permittedOnly: Only settlements covered by your operating permissions for this sector.
proposals.chooseSettlement: Choose a settlement to see its service points.
proposals.servicePointsHint: Public facilities only; never a household.
proposals.saveToAttach: Save the draft first, then attach files.
proposals.overlapResponseHint: OPM uses this to decide how the work is divided. It is kept with the proposal.
proposals.submitHint: The proposal goes to the OPM review queue. Scope, location and budget are locked while it is reviewed.
proposals.notEligible: Your organisation is not eligible to submit proposals
proposals.resubmitHint: Your revised proposal returns to the OPM review queue as a new version.
proposals.resubmitted: Revised proposal sent back to OPM.
proposals.changesRequestedNext: Revise the proposal below, explain how you addressed the comment, and resubmit.
proposals.underReviewNotice: OPM is reviewing this proposal. You will be notified of the decision.
proposals.approvedBody: Approved scope, location and budget are locked. To change them, submit a change request for OPM to decide.
proposals.overlapsAfterSubmit: Overlap checks run when the proposal is submitted.
proposals.noOverlaps: No overlapping work in the same settlement, sector and period.
proposals.overlapExplain: Other work in the same settlement and sector overlaps in time. OPM records how the work is divided before approving.
proposals.lockedScope: Approved scope, location, dates and budget cannot be changed directly. Nothing changes until OPM approves a change request.
proposals.changeOpen: A change request is already with OPM. You can submit another once it is decided.

issues.title: Enter a title.
issues.targetReach: Enter how many people the work will reach.
issues.location: Describe the location in the settlement.
issues.activities: Add at least one planned activity.
issues.dates: Enter a start date and an end date after it.
issues.milestones: Add at least one milestone, each with a title and a due date inside the implementation period.
issues.budgetLines: Budget lines must each have a name and amount, and add up to the total budget.
issues.outputs: Add at least one expected output.
issues.indicators: Add at least one indicator from this sector with a target.
issues.servicePoints: Choose at least one service point in the settlement.
issues.attachments: Attach at least one supporting document.
issues.permission: Your operating permissions do not cover this settlement and sector.

workspace.title: Interventions
workspace.intro: Approved work: progress, reporting, indicators, budget and correspondence.
workspace.officialNote: Official progress and reporting figures count only field reports OPM has accepted. Items still with OPM are marked.
workspace.approvedNotActive: Approved. The intervention becomes active when OPM accepts its first field report.
workspace.planMarker: The dark marker shows where the plan says you should be today.
workspace.requestChangeLink: Request a change to scope, location, dates or budget
workspace.mapNote: Public service points only. The map never shows households or individuals.
workspace.scheduleHint: One activity report per month, due on the 5th of the following month.
workspace.indicatorsHint: Actual values come from accepted field reports only.
workspace.milestoneHint: It counts as done once OPM acknowledges the update.
workspace.assignHint: Staff see only the interventions they are assigned to.

fieldReports.title: Field activity reports
fieldReports.intro: Report activities under approved interventions. Draft → Submitted → Needs correction or Accepted.
fieldReports.newIntro: Aggregate figures only. Never record names or household details.
fieldReports.noLiveIntervention: Field reports can be created once OPM approves an intervention.
fieldReports.acceptedOnly: Only reports OPM accepts update official intervention progress and reporting figures.
fieldReports.fieldAppHint: Records captured on the field application appear here while they are saved offline or waiting to sync.
fieldReports.noOffline: No records waiting on a device.
fieldReports.captured: Offline record created on the simulated field application.
fieldReports.aggregateOnly: Numbers of people reached, in aggregate. No names or household details.
fieldReports.resubmitted: Corrected report sent back to OPM.
fieldReports.noPermission: Your administrator has not given you permission to submit field reports.
fieldReports.returnedTitle: OPM returned this report for correction
fieldReports.returnedNext: Correct the report below, explain the correction, and resubmit. The earlier version stays in the history.
fieldReports.awaitingOpm: Submitted. OPM is reviewing it; it does not count towards official figures yet.
fieldReports.acceptedNote: Accepted by OPM. It now counts towards the intervention's official progress and indicators.
fieldReports.savedOfflineBody: Saved offline on a device. It reaches OPM when the device reconnects and syncs.
fieldReports.awaitingSyncBody: The device is back online and the record is queued to sync.
fieldReports.versionsHint: Each submission is kept. A correction never overwrites an earlier version.

issues.title: Enter a report title.
issues.collectedAt: Enter an activity date that is not in the future and not before the intervention started.
issues.servicePoint: Choose one of the intervention's service points.
issues.gps: Enter valid GPS coordinates, or clear them.
issues.reached: Enter the number of people reached (at least one).
issues.indicators: Indicator values must be zero or more.
issues.distributed: Add at least one distributed item with quantity and households.

surveys.title: Surveys and data collection
surveys.intro: Forms assigned to your interventions, their collection periods, versions and your submissions.
surveys.emptyBody: Forms are assigned when OPM approves an intervention.
surveys.noPermission: Your administrator has not given you permission to collect survey responses.
surveys.versionRetained: Each response keeps the version it was collected on, even after a newer version is published.
surveys.olderVersion: Collected on version {used}. The current version is {current}; this response keeps version {used}.
surveys.gpsHint: Latitude, longitude of the service point.
surveys.photoHint: File name of the photo (simulated; not stored).
surveys.indicatorHint: Linked to an indicator: counts once the response is accepted.
surveys.numberInvalid: Enter a number of zero or more.

beneficiaries.title: Beneficiary verification and assistance
beneficiaries.intro: Request verification and record assistance delivered under approved interventions, with only the information the task needs.
beneficiaries.privacy1: You see only your organisation's entries. You cannot browse the national beneficiary database or other organisations' assistance.
beneficiaries.privacy2: Record only the reference number and what was delivered. Never names, phone numbers or addresses.
beneficiaries.privacy3: A possible duplicate opens a review for an authorised OPM reviewer. It never labels anyone as fraudulent and never stops assistance.
beneficiaries.noLive: Verification and assistance can be recorded once OPM approves an intervention.
beneficiaries.verificationHint: Only the reference number and, optionally, household size are sent. Results are fictional and labelled simulated.
beneficiaries.referenceInvalid: Enter a reference in the format UG-NKV-0418-72.
beneficiaries.purposeHint: Why verification is needed for this task.
beneficiaries.requested: Verification requested. Collect the result when ready.
beneficiaries.demoHint: Demo: references ending 00 are unavailable at first, 9 inconclusive, 7 need review; others verify.
beneficiaries.assistanceHint: Record what was delivered, when and where. A simulated history check looks for possible duplicates.
beneficiaries.useVerificationHint: Use a completed verification so the reference is not typed again.
beneficiaries.flaggedTitle: Possible duplicate: sent for OPM review
beneficiaries.flaggedBody: A similar entry exists for this reference within 30 days. An authorised OPM reviewer will look at the facts. Assistance is not denied, and no one is labelled fraudulent.
beneficiaries.clearedBody: OPM reviewed the flag and found no duplicate.
beneficiaries.correctedBody: OPM reviewed the flag and corrected the distribution record. Assistance was not withdrawn.
beneficiaries.minimumData: Only the minimum information needed is stored.
beneficiaries.reviewPrivacy: The review content, including any other organisation's records, is visible only to the authorised OPM reviewer.
beneficiaries.noReview: No review has been raised for this entry.

issues.beneficiaryRef: Enter a reference in the format UG-NKV-0418-72, or choose a verification.
issues.quantity: Enter a quantity of at least one.
issues.valueUsd: Enter a value of zero or more, or leave it blank.
issues.deliveredAt: Enter a delivery date that is not in the future and not before the intervention started.
issues.servicePoint: Choose one of the intervention's service points.

finance.title: Funding and expenditure
finance.intro: Approved budget, funding source and expenditure you report for OPM review.
finance.ampBody: RPCMS holds intervention-level implementation information. Any exchange with AMP is made by OPM through an authorised integration. In this prototype every AMP exchange is simulated; nothing is sent.
finance.emptyBody: Expenditure can be reported once OPM approves an intervention.
finance.varianceHint: {spent}% of the budget spent (accepted) with {time}% of the implementation period elapsed.
finance.noPermission: Your administrator has not given you permission to submit financial updates.
finance.supportNote: Supporting document for an expenditure update.
finance.saved: Expenditure update saved as a draft.
finance.returnedHint: OPM returned this update. Read the comment, correct the entries, and resubmit.

issues.entryDate: Each entry needs a date inside the implementation period.
issues.entryAmount: Each entry needs an amount above zero.
issues.entryLine: Each entry needs a budget line.

agreements.title: MoUs and approvals
agreements.intro: Agreements involving your organisation: versions, OPM review, signature requests and final status.
agreements.simulated: Electronic signing and signer authentication are simulated in this prototype. No signing or identity service is contacted.
agreements.emptyBody: OPM prepares the memorandum of understanding after it approves the accreditation.
agreements.requestedBody: OPM requested the authorised signatory's signature on {date}. Review the agreement and respond.
agreements.notSignatory: A signature is requested. Only an authorised signatory in your organisation can respond.
agreements.declinedBody: Signature declined. OPM will review your reason and may send a new version.
agreements.inOpmReview: OPM is reviewing the draft before requesting a signature.
agreements.signHint: Signing records your typed name as the signature. This stands in for a real electronic signature and authentication.
agreements.typedName: Type your full name to sign
agreements.confirmAuthority: I am authorised to sign for my organisation.
agreements.confirmRequired: Confirm that you are authorised to sign.
agreements.declineReason: Reason, or the changes you need
agreements.signedDone: Signed (simulated). OPM can see the signature.

reports.title: Partner reports
reports.intro: Previews and reports on your organisation's own work. Exports contain the same aggregate tables as the screen.
reports.scopeNote: Reports include only your organisation's records you can see. Exports follow the same rules: no beneficiary references or personal details.
reports.freezeNote: Figures are frozen when the report is generated.
reports.noExport: Exports need the Export reports permission.
reports.fileClassification: Internal — aggregate figures only; prototype with fictional data.
reports.frozen: Headline figures are frozen at generation. Tables show the current records.
reports.privacyNote: Aggregate figures and record references only.

messages.title: Messages and notifications
messages.intro: OPM decisions, requests for changes, deadlines, expiring documents and sync problems. Every item links to its record.
messages.formalHint: Formal correspondence is part of the record: OPM sees your replies and they are kept in the audit trail.
messages.notesHint: Internal notes are visible only inside your organisation. OPM never sees them.
messages.replyHint: Visible to OPM on the record.

notify.syncStale: {ref} has been waiting on a device for more than three days
notify.assistanceFlagged: {ref}: possible duplicate sent for OPM review (assistance continues)

team.title: Team and settings
team.intro: Your organisation's users, their roles, permissions and assigned interventions, and your activity history.
team.boundaries: Partner administrators manage only their own organisation's users. They cannot grant OPM permissions or give access to another organisation.
team.name: Name
team.permissionsHint: Delegated permissions. Administrator-only permissions cannot be given to staff.
team.selfNote: You cannot change your own access.
team.deactivateHint: The user can no longer sign in. Their records and history are kept.
team.inviteSimulated: The invitation email is simulated; nothing is sent.
team.activityHint: Actions on your organisation's records, by your users and by OPM. Read-only.

connectivity.backOnline: Connection restored. Records waiting on this device are not sent until you sync.
connectivity.wentOffline: You are offline. New work is saved on this device only.

offline.banner: You are offline. Work you save stays on this device; the central system has not changed.
offline.bannerSimulated: Offline mode is simulated for the demonstration. Work you save stays on this device; the central system has not changed.
offline.needsConnectionBody: This action works with the central system, so it is not available offline. Your saved work is safe on this device.

source.cached: Showing your assigned work as saved on this device at {at}. It may be out of date.
source.loading: Showing the copy saved on this device at {at} while the latest information loads.
source.noneTitle: Nothing saved on this device yet
source.noneBody: Connect once to download your assigned work. After that, it is available offline.

common.earlierVersions: Earlier versions kept on this device ({count})
common.earlierVersionsNote: Nothing is discarded silently. These are copies of this record from before a correction, a conflict decision or a form-version change.

previousReason.formVersionRetired: Answers on the retired form version

events.createdOffline: Started on this device while offline
events.savedOffline: Saved offline, waiting for a connection
events.withdrawn: Taken out of the queue for editing
events.correcting: Reopened to fix a sync error
events.synced: Received by the central system as {ref}
events.syncedReplay: Confirmed by the central system as {ref} (no duplicate created)
events.interrupted: Upload interrupted; kept on this device
events.migrated: Answers moved from version {from} to version {to}

work.title: My work
work.countReadyOffline: Ready to sync (waiting for a connection)

walkthrough.title: Demonstration walkthrough
walkthrough.intro: One connected, fictional scenario. Each step is worked out from what is actually on this device and in the central system.
walkthrough.offlineDone: The device is now offline. Two changes were made centrally while you are away (simulated).
walkthrough.completeBody: OPM accepted the corrected report. Its figures now count in the intervention's indicators, the OPM map and reports.

s1.title: Open an assigned intervention while online
s1.body: The device saves your assigned work so it is available offline.

s2.title: The device goes offline
s2.body: From now on, work is saved on this device only.
s2.hint: While you are away, OPM publishes version 3 of the antenatal survey and your supervisor corrects the dignity-kit allocation. The device cannot know until it reconnects.

s3.title: Complete a GPS-tagged visit, a survey and an assistance task
s3.body: Record the visit with a GPS position (or a reason), collect the survey, and record the delivery. Save each one.

s4.title: All three are unsynced
s4.body: The sync centre shows them as saved on this device. No central record has changed.

s5.title: Reconnect and start the sync
s5.body: Go back online, then press Sync now.

s6.title: One syncs, one fails validation, one has a conflict
s6.body: The visit report is received. The survey is rejected because its form version was retired. The delivery conflicts with the supervisor's change.

s7.title: Fix the error and resolve the conflict
s7.body: Move the survey answers to version 3 and answer the new question. Choose how to resolve the conflict; both versions are kept.

s8.title: OPM returns the report for correction
s8.body: The reviewer's comment appears beside the field that needs attention.
s8.hint: Stands in for the OPM reviewer (or sign in as coordinator.demo and return it in Field monitoring).
s8.done: The report was returned with a comment on people reached.

s9.title: Correct, resubmit, and OPM accepts
s9.body: Fix the figures and resubmit; the earlier version stays in the history. Acceptance updates the indicators and reporting.
s9.hint: Stands in for the OPM reviewer (or accept it in the OPM workspace).
s9.done: OPM accepted the report. Indicators and reports now include it.

task.worksOffline: This works offline: the record is saved on this device and sent when you sync.

denied.title: Not available to you
denied.task: This task is not assigned to you, or it is not in the information saved on this device.
denied.intervention: This intervention is not assigned to you. You can only open interventions you are assigned to in your settlement.
denied.permissionTitle: You are not authorised for this
denied.permissionBody: Your account does not include this permission. Only officers authorised under the approved process can verify beneficiaries or record assistance. Ask your supervisor if you need it.

interventions.title: Interventions
interventions.intro: Approved interventions assigned to you. You can view the plan, but not change it.
interventions.none: No interventions are assigned to you.
interventions.scopeNote: The approved scope, location, dates and budget can change only through your organisation's change request to OPM. Field reports do not change them.
interventions.reportingDefault: Report each activity after it happens, with aggregate figures only.
interventions.resultsNote: Only reports OPM has accepted count here. Records saved on your device or under review do not.

reports.title: Visit and activity reports
reports.intro: Your reports, wherever they are: on this device, in the central system, or reviewed.
reports.notOnDevice: This report is not on this device and is not among your submissions.
reports.titlePlaceholder: For example: Outreach day at Juru
reports.activityHint: Choose an assigned activity or describe it.
reports.observationsHint: What you saw. Do not include names or anything that identifies a person.
reports.reachedHint: Totals only. Never record names or individual details.
reports.followUpHint: Who needs to do what next.
reports.attachmentsHint: For example, a photo of the signed attendance register. Do not photograph people without their consent.

errors.visitAt: Enter the visit date and time (not in the future).
errors.gps: Capture the GPS location or give a reason it is unavailable.
errors.reached: Enter whole numbers (0 or more) for women, men and children.
errors.indicators: Indicator values must be 0 or more.

reports.incompleteBody: You can save a draft now and finish later. To submit, complete:
reports.serverFields: The central system asked you to check: {fields}.
reports.noPhotoWarning: No photo is attached. Visit reports without evidence go to extra review.
reports.correctionHint: This reply is shown to the reviewer with the corrected version.
reports.submitOnlineNote: Submitting sends the report to the central system now. Its status will show here.
reports.submitOfflineNote: You are offline: the report is saved on this device and sent when you sync. The central system does not change until then.
reports.savedOffline: Saved offline. It will be sent when you sync.
reports.autosaved: Saved on this device at {at}. Not yet sent.
reports.deviceOnlyOnline: Drafts are saved on this device as you type. Nothing is sent until you submit.
reports.deviceOnlyOffline: Offline: everything is saved on this device only.
reports.returnedBody: The reviewer's comments are shown beside the fields that need attention. Your earlier submission is kept in the history.
reports.centralHistoryNote: Every submitted version is kept. A correction adds a version; it never replaces the earlier one.
reports.discardConfirm: Delete this draft from the device? This cannot be undone.

explain.savedOffline: Saved on this device only. The central system has not received it.
explain.readyToSync: Ready to sync: saved on this device and waiting in the upload queue. Not sent yet.
explain.syncing: Uploading now. It stays on this device until the central system confirms it.
explain.interrupted: The upload did not finish. The record is safe on this device; retrying will not create a duplicate.

gps.capturedAt: Captured {at}. Check the position before you submit.
gps.lowAccuracy: Low accuracy. Try again in the open if you can.

gps.noGps: GPS is not available for this visit

reasons.noSignal: No GPS signal at the site

files.hint: Photos are compressed and kept on this device until they are uploaded.
files.compressing: Compressing and saving on this device…
files.tooLarge: Files other than photos must be smaller than 5 MB.
files.storageError: The file could not be saved on this device. Free some space and try again.

sync.title: Sync centre
sync.intro: What is on this device, what is waiting, and what has reached the central system.
sync.browserOffline: The browser reports no network connection.
sync.neverLong: This device has not synced yet.
sync.cacheTaken: Assigned work saved on this device at {at}.
sync.offlineHint: Syncing needs a connection. Your records are safe on this device until then.
sync.simulateOfflineHint: Behaves exactly like having no connection: nothing is sent or read from the central system.
sync.simulateUnstableHint: Slower uploads, and the first reply from the central system is lost, so you can see a safe retry.
sync.autoSync: Sync automatically when a connection returns
sync.autoSyncHint: Off for the demonstration, so you can start the sync yourself.
sync.deviceOnlyIntro: Drafts and records not yet submitted. They never leave the device until you submit them.
sync.queueOffline: Saved offline, waiting for a connection
sync.queueIntro: Complete records waiting to be sent. The central system has not received them.

progress.confirming: Waiting for the central system to confirm…

sync.syncedIntro: Received centrally. Their review status comes from the central system.
sync.syncedEmpty: Nothing has been synced from this device yet.
sync.removeSynced: Remove synced copies from this device
sync.removed: {count} synced copies removed. Drafts and queued records were not touched.
sync.keptOnDevice: The record is kept on this device ({at}).
sync.moveNeedsLatest: Connect to download the current form version.

FORM_VERSION_RETIRED.title: Rejected: form version retired
FORM_VERSION_RETIRED.body: Version {version} of this form was retired centrally before you collected this response. The central system accepts it only on the current version ({current}). Your answers are kept; move them to the current version and answer any new questions.

COLLECTION_CLOSED.title: Rejected: collection period closed
COLLECTION_CLOSED.body: The response is dated outside the form's collection period. It is kept on this device; ask your supervisor what to do.

MISSING_ANSWERS.title: Rejected: answers missing
MISSING_ANSWERS.body: Some required answers are missing or not valid.

MISSING_FIELDS.title: Rejected: information missing
MISSING_FIELDS.body: The central system found missing or invalid information.

NOT_ASSIGNED.title: Rejected: not assigned to you
NOT_ASSIGNED.body: This work is no longer assigned to you. The record is kept on this device; ask your supervisor.

INTERVENTION_CLOSED.title: Rejected: reporting closed
INTERVENTION_CLOSED.body: The intervention is not open for reporting. The record is kept on this device.

INVALID_REFERENCE.title: Rejected: reference not valid
INVALID_REFERENCE.body: The household or beneficiary reference is not in the approved format or does not match the task.

NOT_RETURNED.title: Already reviewed
NOT_RETURNED.body: {ref} is no longer waiting for a correction. The correction is kept on this device.

TASK_CANCELLED.title: Task cancelled
TASK_CANCELLED.body: Task {ref} was cancelled centrally. The record is kept on this device; ask your supervisor.

PERMISSION.title: Not permitted
PERMISSION.body: Your account no longer has the permission this record needs.

CONNECTION_LOST.title: Connection lost during upload
CONNECTION_LOST.body: The upload stopped part-way. Nothing was lost, and retrying is safe.

REPLY_LOST.title: No reply from the central system
REPLY_LOST.body: The connection dropped before the central system replied. The record may already be saved centrally. Retrying is safe: the central system recognises it and will not create a duplicate.

SERVER_ERROR.title: Upload failed
SERVER_ERROR.body: Something went wrong during the upload. The record is kept on this device; retry later.

OFFLINE.title: No connection
OFFLINE.body: The device went offline. Retry when you are connected.

UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Signed out
UNAUTHENTICATED.body: Sign in again to sync. The record stays on this device.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not permitted
FORBIDDEN.body: Your account does not permit this upload.

INVALID_STATE.title: Could not upload
INVALID_STATE.body: The record was in an unexpected state. Retry.

DEVICE_STORAGE.title: Device storage full
DEVICE_STORAGE.body: The device could not save the result. Free some space and retry.

conflict.title: Version conflict
conflict.intro: Task {ref} changed centrally after you started (version {base} → {central}), by {by} at {at}.
conflict.tableCaption: Your copy compared with the central version
conflict.nothingLost: Nothing has been overwritten. Whichever you choose, both versions are kept: the central task keeps every version, and this device keeps your original entry.
conflict.chooseLegend: How do you want to resolve it?
conflict.keepMineHint: Send what you actually delivered, against the new version. The difference goes to your supervisor to check. Nothing is labelled as wrong.
conflict.useCentralHint: Only if what you delivered matches the updated task. Your record returns to draft so you can check it before sending.
conflict.noteHint: Recorded with the decision and shown to your supervisor.
conflict.resolvedQueued: Decision recorded. It will be sent when you sync.
conflict.resolvedDraft: Decision recorded. Check the record, then submit it again.

surveys.title: Forms and surveys
surveys.intro: Questionnaires assigned to you, by intervention, collection period and version. You can collect responses offline.
surveys.offlineOk: Offline: new responses use version {version}, as saved on this device.
surveys.notOnDevice: This response is not on this device.
surveys.savedAsYouGo: Each answer is saved on this device as you go. You can stop and resume later.
surveys.number: Enter a number of 0 or more.
surveys.gpsHint: Enter the coordinates or a location description.
surveys.photoHint: Name the photo you took (attach photos in a visit report).
surveys.versionKept: This response stays on form version {version}, whatever changes later.
surveys.submitted: Response sent. See its status above.
surveys.savedOffline: Saved offline. It will be sent when you sync.
surveys.migrated: Version {from} was retired, so your answers were moved to version {to}. Answer the new questions; the original answers are kept on this device.

verify.title: Beneficiary verification
verify.intro: For officers authorised to deliver assistance. Enter or scan only the reference the approved process requires.
verify.privacyBody: No names, photos, contact details or protection information are collected or shown. References are masked in lists and removed from this device after upload.
verify.offlineBody: No live check can happen without a connection, and none is pretended. You can queue the request: it shows as Pending sync until the check runs. Under the approved process you may still record a delivery with verification pending; any mismatch goes to an authorised reviewer and the person is not refused assistance because a check could not run.
verify.offlinePermitted: Record a delivery with verification pending
verify.referenceHint: Format: UG-NKV-0418-72. Nothing else is needed.
verify.scanUnsupported: Scanning is not supported in this browser. Type the reference instead.
verify.cameraDenied: Camera permission was declined. Type the reference instead.
verify.badCode: A code was read, but it is not a reference in the approved format.
verify.scanned: Reference read from the code. Check it before you continue.
verify.householdSizeHint: Only if your process requires it.
verify.purpose: Purpose of the check (as explained to the person)
verify.purposeHint: Say this to the person in a language they understand.
verify.purposeDefault: To confirm eligibility before delivering assistance under “{intervention}”.
verify.consent: I explained the purpose of this check. The person understands it and agrees to it.
verify.onlineNote: The check uses ProGres v4, SIMULATED in this prototype. The result is not a real UNHCR verification.
verify.offlineNote: Offline: nothing is checked now. The request waits on this device.
verify.simulatedNote: Simulated ProGres v4 response. No real registration record was consulted.
verify.notYetChecked: No check has taken place yet. This request is saved on this device.

next.verified: Verified. You can record the delivery.
next.inconclusive: Inconclusive. Record the delivery if your process allows; the result goes with it for a reviewer.
next.unavailable: The verification service did not respond. Try again later. You may record the delivery with verification pending; it will be reviewed.
next.needs_review: Routed to an authorised reviewer. Do not refuse assistance on this basis; follow your supervisor's instructions.
next.pending: Pending sync: no verification has happened yet.

errors.beneficiaryRef: Enter a reference in the format UG-NKV-0418-72.
errors.householdSize: Household size must be a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.purpose: State the purpose of the check.
errors.consent: Confirm the person understands the purpose of the check.

assistance.title: Assistance delivery
assistance.intro: Record assistance delivered under an approved intervention. The status always shows whether it is only on this device, synced, or reviewed.
assistance.stateLocal: saved on this device only. No central record exists yet.
assistance.stateSynced: the central system has the record. The history check runs there.
assistance.stateReviewed: an authorised reviewer has checked a flagged record.
assistance.notOnDevice: This delivery is not on this device.
assistance.householdHint: The minimum reference only, e.g. UG-NKV-0533-14. No names.
assistance.linkVerification: Link the verification request for this reference
assistance.verificationOptional: Verification is optional under the approved process. Without it, the delivery is recorded with verification pending.
assistance.historyNote: Only your organisation's records are shown. After sync, the central system compares other organisations' records; a possible duplicate goes to a human reviewer and never stops this delivery.
assistance.historyNone: No earlier assistance from your organisation.
assistance.evidenceHint: For example, a photo of the signed receipt. Do not photograph the person.
assistance.differsFromAllocation: This is different from the allocation ({allocated}). That is allowed: record what was actually delivered. Your supervisor will see the difference.
assistance.duplicateNote: If the central check finds a possible duplicate, the record is flagged for human review. Nobody is labelled fraudulent and support is not denied automatically.
assistance.submitOnlineNote: Online: the delivery is sent to the central system now.
assistance.submitOfflineNote: Offline: the delivery is recorded on this device only and sent when you sync.
assistance.sent: Sent to the central system. See the status above.
assistance.recordedLocally: Recorded locally. It will be sent when you sync.
assistance.explainLocal: Recorded locally: this delivery is only on this device. No central record has changed.
assistance.explainSynced: Synced as {ref}. The central history check found nothing to review.
assistance.explainFlagged: Synced as {ref} and flagged for human review: a reviewer will compare it with earlier records. This does not mean anything was wrong, and the delivery stands.
assistance.purged: The full reference was removed from this device after upload.
assistance.useCentralCheck: You chose the central version. Check that the quantity matches what you delivered before sending.

errors.householdRef: Enter a reference in the format UG-NKV-0533-14.
errors.valueUsd: The value must be 0 or more.
errors.deliveredAt: Enter when it was delivered (not in the future).

map.title: Settlement map and service points
map.intro: Your assigned settlement, intervention locations, service points and scheduled visits.
map.privacy: Only settlement centres and public facilities are shown. Individual refugee homes are never placed on a map.
map.tilesFailed: The map background could not load. The positions below come from the data saved on this device.
map.offlineSchematic: Offline: showing a simple plan drawn from the coordinates saved on this device.
map.listHint: The list view gives the same information for screen readers and slow connections.
map.cached: Saved for offline use: {points} service points in {settlements} settlement (your assigned area only).

issues.title: Issues and referrals
issues.intro: Flag a problem or refer a service need. It goes to the team responsible, and you can follow its status here.
issues.urgentTitle: If someone is in immediate danger
issues.urgentBody: Follow your organisation's safeguarding procedure and contact the protection desk directly. Do not wait for a sync.
issues.raise: What do you want to raise?

categoryHints.service_gap: A service that is missing or not reaching people.
categoryHints.safeguarding: Restricted: goes only to the protection desk.
categoryHints.failed_distribution: A distribution that did not happen or went wrong.
categoryHints.follow_up: Something your supervisor needs to follow up.
categoryHints.referral: Send a person's service need to the caseworker team.

issues.notOnDevice: This item is not on this device.
issues.safeguardingBody: Describe the concern without names or identifying details. Only the protection desk sees the details. After upload, the description is removed from this device.
issues.referralIntro: The caseworker team receives the need and contacts the person through the help desk. You will see the referral's status, but not the case itself.
issues.locationNoteHint: A public landmark, never a home address.
issues.descriptionHint: What is happening, since when, and who is affected (numbers, not names).
issues.descriptionSafeguarding: No names or identifying details. Say what you observed and when.
issues.descriptionReferral: The service need only. The caseworker team collects personal details directly.
issues.referralConsent: The person agreed to be referred and to be contacted by the caseworker team.
issues.evidenceHint: Photos of the problem, not of people.
issues.evidenceRestricted: Only if permitted by your procedure. Never photograph the people involved.
issues.submitOfflineNote: Offline: saved on this device and sent when you sync.
issues.sent: Sent. Its status will show here.
issues.savedOffline: Saved offline. It will be sent when you sync.
issues.referralNote: You can follow the status. The case itself is only open to authorised caseworkers.
issues.restrictedNote: Restricted: only the receiving team sees the details and working notes.
issues.purged: Removed from this device after upload to protect the people involved.

errors.consent: Confirm the person agreed to the referral.
errors.location: Choose a service point in your settlement.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Assignments, deadlines, returned reports, review comments and sync problems.
notifications.cachedNote: Offline: notifications from the central system are shown as of the last sync.

notify.fieldTaskReassigned: Task {ref} was reassigned to someone else
notify.fieldAllocationDifference: Task {ref}: {delivered} delivered against an allocation of {allocated}

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.permissionsNote: Set by your organisation and supervisor. They apply only in your assigned settlement.
account.cannot: No field role can browse the national beneficiary database or open another organisation's restricted records.
account.languageNote: Your choice applies on this device.
account.languageOffline: Changing the language needs a connection, because the screens are downloaded again.
account.deviceSummary: {records} records on this device, {unsynced} not yet synced.
account.installHint: To install, use your browser's menu: Install app or Add to Home screen.
account.installIos: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
account.offlineShell: Once installed or visited online, the screens open without a connection (production build).
account.signOutNote: Records not yet synced stay on this device for your account and are sent when you sign in again.
account.unsyncedTitle: {count} records are only on this device
account.unsyncedBody: They stay on this device for your account and are not deleted. Sync first if you can.

team.title: Team and review
team.intro: Assign and review your team's work in your settlement.
team.needsConnection: Team information is read live from the central system and is not stored on this device. Connect to assign or review work.
team.assigned: Task assigned. The officer is notified.
team.changed: Task changed. A new version was recorded.
team.returned: Returned. The officer sees your comment beside the field.
team.reviewNote: OPM makes the final decision. You can return a report or record that you checked it.
team.restrictedIssue: Restricted: details are only visible to the receiving team.
team.scope: You see only your organisation's work in {settlement}.

errors.title: Enter a title.
errors.servicePoint: Choose a service point of this intervention.
errors.allocation: Enter a valid household reference, assistance type and quantity.

queue.title: Team queue
queue.intro: Cases routed to your team, waiting to be claimed.
queue.empty: No cases waiting in the team queue.

myCases.title: My cases
myCases.intro: Cases you have claimed and are working.
myCases.empty: You haven't claimed any cases yet.
